result.reasoning: This commit ("Introduce allowed keys table per API client") added the erroneous fall-through migration case `case 7: // consolidate` followed immediately by `case 8:` with the actual migration logic, without properly incrementing DATABASE_VERSION to account for both steps distinctly. This created the double-counted/misaligned case numbering in the onUpgrade() switch statement that the fix commit corrects by removing the redundant "// consolidate" case and renumbering all subsequent case labels down by one. The blame on the modified lines in the fix directly traces to this commit as the origin of the case-7/case-8 split that caused the off-by-one migration bug.
